summary: First phase of session loading: pops the session queue, returns early when the range width (upper minus lower angle bound) is not positive, resolves a loading resource, then iterates the vehicle array to initialise per-vehicle effect tables and state/visibility bytes. Afterwards sets angle clamp mode, marks the loading-phase flag, and runs state-trigger checks in a loop bounded by a 0.75 accumulator. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the range width check fails.

operations.description: Pop one entry from the session loading queue at entry.
Return 0 when the range width, computed as the upper bound at +0xF34 minus the lower bound at +0xF30, is not positive.
Resolve the loading resource and store its handle into the field at +0xF40.
Set the clamp-mode byte at +0xF81 to 1.
Iterate over the vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) for the vehicle count given by dword_5C329C.
Remove multi-object effects for the current session range bound.
Initialise effect data tables for the current vehicle (vehicle pointer plus 1776).
Store the vehicle+13000 DWORD into the per-vehicle slot at field +0x734.
Copy the vehicle+4189 byte into the driver state slot 104 bytes before the array headed at field +0x93C.
Write the boolean (vehicle+18620 bit 2 is set) into the per-vehicle array slot at field +0x93C.
Transition the session state machine to state 3.
Apply angle clamping/wrapping driven by dbl_8AFEA0 via AngleClampWrap.
Set the conditional index via ConditionalIndexSetter(0).
Set the loading-phase byte at +0xF80 to 1.
Accumulate dbl_8AFE90 into a loop value used as the iteration bound.
Run ReciprocalWithSignCheck on flt_5EA4E8 with the value 0.75.
Loop calling StateTriggerCheck while the accumulated value stays below 0.75.
